channel.title: Governance Digest: optimism
channel.description: New DAO governance proposals and discussions, summarized in plain English.

item.title: Security Council: Lead Election (optimism)
item.description: Optimism opens the election for the Security Council Lead, a 24-month role that now also recruits and nominates the Council's key holders. Self-nominations close 25 November.

item.title: What factors should be considered when selecting Security Council members? (optimism)
item.description: A community member proposes ten criteria for choosing Optimism Security Council members, including independence, disclosure and ongoing monitoring, while a separate proposal to change selection is under discussion.

item.title: Maintenance Upgrade Proposal: Soneium Mainnet Proposer Rotation and Fee Vault Config Update (optimism)
item.description: A maintenance upgrade proposal would rotate the Soneium dispute game proposer to OP Enterprise and repoint two fee vaults to its cost recipient, as Soneium's operator moves from Sony to the Optimism Foundation.

item.title: Proposal for Sequencer Fee Rebates on OP Mainnet (optimism)
item.description: The Optimism Foundation asks to rebate part of OP Mainnet sequencer fees to select partners, for activity those partners bring, paid in ETH fee revenue rather than OP.

item.title: Maintenance Upgrade Proposal: OP Mainnet Proposer Rotation (optimism)
item.description: OP Labs proposes rotating the proposer key on OP Mainnet's permissioned fallback dispute game to new OP Enterprise infrastructure; it passes unless vetoed during a one-week window.
